messages.text: 'use proactively' marking found — encourages autonomous delegation

writing.overall_comment: A solid, well-scoped frontend generalist agent that would benefit from an explicit output contract, handback criteria, and trimming of repeated framework guidance.

dimensions.name: Delegation fit
dimensions.comment: The description clearly names frameworks and triggers (build/style/refactor components, pages, state), so a main agent can route confidently.

dimensions.name: Prompt quality
dimensions.comment: Role, constraints, and framework-specific practices are explicit, but there is no defined output contract (deliverable format, level of testing/verification expected).

dimensions.name: Boundaries
dimensions.comment: A '不应做' list exists (no framework mixing, no hardcoded secrets, no skipping a11y) but there is no guidance on when to hand back or escalate, e.g., when requirements or stack are ambiguous.

dimensions.name: Conciseness
dimensions.comment: Content is moderate but redundant—framework detection and preferred libraries are restated across core duties, specific focus, and workflow sections, inflating token cost.

suggestions: Add an explicit output contract to the prompt/skill that defines the deliverable format and the expected level of testing or verification.
Add escalation or hand-back criteria to the '不应做' list or workflow section for when requirements or the stack are ambiguous.
Consolidate framework detection and preferred libraries into a single section, removing redundant restatements from core duties, specific focus, and workflow.
